verdict.rationale: SerpApi is a search-results scraping API, and in-product AI insights are a fair question for a SaaS service, so the axis applies. The pack shows no feature where SerpApi itself generates AI insights or suggestions from the user's data. Its LLM-oriented features (markdown output, the MCP server, RAG use cases, and scraping third-party AI Mode/AI Overview results) are adjacent capabilities or developer building blocks, not in-product AI analysis.
